## Overview
This document outlines the cancellation policies for hotel reservations, car rental reservations, and packaged trip bookings managed by our travel company.

---

## 1. Hotel Reservation Cancellation

| Window | Fee |
|---|---|
| More than 7 days before check-in | **No fee** (full refund) |
| 3–7 days before check-in | **50 %** of the first night's rate |

## 2. Car Rental Reservation Cancellation

| Window | Fee |
|---|---|
| More than 48 hours before pick-up | **No fee** (full refund) |
| 24–48 hours before pick-up | **$50 flat fee** |
| Less than 24 hours before pick-up | **100 %** of the first day's rate |
| No-show | **100 %** of the entire rental cost |

- Prepaid fuel or insurance add-ons are refunded in full when the reservation itself is cancelled (any window).
- One-way drop-off fees that were prepaid are **non-refundable** once the vehicle has been picked up.

---

## 3. Packaged Trip Booking Cancellation

Packaged trips bundle flights, hotels, and/or car rentals into a single booking.

| Window | Fee |
|---|---|
| More than 14 days before departure | **25 %** of total package price |
| 7–14 days before departure | **50 %** of total package price |
| 3–7 days before departure | **75 %** of total package price |
| Less than 3 days before departure | **100 %** (no refund) |

- The "departure" date is the earliest service start date in the package (e.g., outbound flight date).
- Partial cancellation (e.g., dropping only the car rental from a package) is **not** supported; the entire package must be cancelled and rebooked if changes are needed.

---

## 4. General Rules

1. All cancellation requests must be submitted through the reservation system (CLI or agent).
2. Cancellation fees are calculated based on the **local time of the service location** at the moment the cancellation is confirmed.
3. Refund processing takes **5–10 business days** to the original payment method.
4. Travel insurance (if purchased separately) may cover cancellation fees — check your insurance policy for details.
5. Force-majeure exceptions (natural disasters, government travel bans, etc.) are handled on a case-by-case basis and may waive fees at management discretion.

---

*Last updated: 2025*
